nom: Avène Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Cream

avis.titre: I have to give it 5 stars
avis.texte: This is the only product that has helped with my perioral dematitis flare ups. I have been struggling for the past 4 months with PD and i couldnt control the reaction i had on my skin. I would feel completely insecure but i was recommended this product and i can honestly say it helped me clear up the PD. It was the only product that has done wonders to my skin 10/10 recommend.

My dermatologist gave me a sample of this lotion. After trying it at home on my sensitive skin, I was super impressed. After a bad bout of dermatitis, my skin barrier is still healing, and this is the only lotion which helps. It calms redness, soothes, and feels great. It's good at night and under makeup. It's worth every penny and I'm a fan for life!

Sensitive acne prone combo skin. 2.5 days using this and had horrible painful pimples develop around jawline/mouth/cheeks. I even patch tested on eyes and neck for a week prior to using on face. Definitely clogs pores and very oily/sits on top of skin.

As someone with very acne prone skin (forehead, nose, cheeks, chin, mouth), perioral dermatitis, dehydrated combo skin, and redness, I was very disappointed with this product. This came up on my research when looking for good moisturizers for my skin type and it broke me out immediately even after all the research I did. Maybe this would work for some people but I would be cautious.

I've been using tretanoin on my skin for the past week and my regular moisturizer began to burn around the nose area today. I had a sample of this product so I decided to see how well it works for reducing redness and burning. There was none at all! Burning was gone! I'm excited to use up my little sample!

This is an amazing cream for dry, mature facial skin. It goes on smoothly and feels good all day. Makeup goes on well over it. I have a couple of minor issues with it, though I will keep buying it. First one, I find I cannot use it around my eye area as it is too rich there and has cause a few milia to appear around my eyes, so I use a less rich lotion around my eyes but use this Avene product all over otherwise. Second one, it is packaged in a sterile form, which it great in many ways, but causes it to be hard to get out of the tube after a while of use, leaving a lot of product hard to get out. The only solutions I have found to be able to keep using the product until it is actually gone is to "milk it" with my fingers down towards the tube bottom, or else, cut the tube open and extract it. I will keep on using however, because otherwise it is really excellent cream.

Truly this has transformed my skin. Repaired my horribly damaged skin barrier and continues to nourish it. Does not break out my sensitive skin, in fact it has really helped my acne. I only use it at night, don't think it would be great under makeup.
Moisturizes my combo skin without making it greasy, soaks into skin quickly, and did not break me out. I've repurchased multiple times.

this was my first time purchasing from this brand and I was looking for something to heal severe dry red patches and inflammation and blemishes due to dry irritated skin, and after 14 days of consistently using this creme my skin barrier is significantly healed! I also notice immediately after applying this creme my skin goes from a hot flushed burning feel to a calm soothed feeling with redness reduced. I am excited to try other products from this brand and will use this again if I need effective efficient healing for my skin

As a middle-aged woman with a giant patch of bright red rosacea on my face and a lifelong history of skin irritation to a number of things… I was very skeptical that anything was going to fix my issues. I bought this after my dermatologist recommended it, along with a different wash. After three months, 90% of my rosacea patches were gone. I use this twice a day and it does not break me out or sting or dry out my skin worse… And best of all it doesn't feel like I'm wearing a layer of cake frosting on my face! absolutely recommend five out of five.
Loved how it healed my skin after contact dermatitis.and dryness. A little goes a long way.
My dermatologist orginally recommened this as a face lotion - I've been happy with it!

avis.titre: I would by this product again and again.
avis.texte: Recommend by top dermatologist to help with allergies. Tried many different products but this product does the job!
This stuff is absolutely amazing! I have really bad eczema on my face and this helps everytime when i have a flar up

avis.titre: ONLY MOISTURIZER THAT WORKS FOR ME
avis.texte: I have been hunting for a lotion since the panthenol rebarrier cream was reformulized (broke out super badly from the new formula) and I noticed too late the Cerave in the tub moisterizer- while not irritating or breaking me out gave me mild congestion over time. My skin hated me for months as I kept testing new moisterizers. Finally I cross referenced all the ingredients (thanks Claude AI) and I found the common trigger was glycols! Who would have thought. Its been 5 days using only this moisterizer and no new breakouts, redness on cheeks coming down, no irritation and no congestion. Who would have thought? This may not work for everyone but it definitely did for me. If you had the same problem as me or similar I highly recommend doing patch tests on everything and observing the effects of each moisterizer for at least a week. Then input every moisterizer in Claude AI and then Claude AI will narrow down the common triggers and be able to recommend something. Anyways this wasnt meant to be a promotion for Claude but here we are. Im just thankful i finally found my holy grail!

avis.titre: Great for rash prone and dermatitis skin
avis.texte: I had peri oral dermatitis for a while and this helped so much in my recovery process. It is VERY rich and hydrating. My skin is so sensitive but this has never burned or hurt it an way. So many "sensitive skin' brands are not actually that sensitive friendly, but this really is. It may be too thick for some people's preference but I'm fine with it.
I bought this because I'm not allergic to it. However, It doesn't feel very moisturizing.
Try it out! I am sensitive and acne prone. This lotion is a must have!

This cream is perfect. Gives the perfect amount of hydration, soaks into skin and doesn't clog pores. doesn't make me shiny throughout the day. it calmed my cheeks immediately and has helped with dry skin around nose/mouth. the tube is a plus and a little does go a long way.

avis.titre: Dry, sensitive, acne prone holy grail
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin that often reacts negatively to skincare. This is the only moisturizer I am able to continually use that actually works for my skin. I am dry and acne prone. I will usually develop irritations to products as I continue to use them (just some examples - La Roche Posay cleanser, Cocokind moisturizers, Clinique moisturizers, Aveeno oat cleaners, First Aid Beauty moisturizer, the list goes on with high end and drugstore products that end in irritation and sometimes acne flares). This cream can be Applied during my most irritated times and does not burn one bit. This is truly the only item i am extremely loyal to and recommend to EVERYONE.

I almost exclusively use Avene at this point because I break out with the teeniest of fragrances. As I've gotten older, my rosacea has taken center stage. This calms it down. A tube lasts months. This lays perfectly under every makeup I use with no pilling. I don't tend to wear tons of foundation because my skin is absolutely radiant, but I can use full coverage MAC, Tarte, Dior, it all goes on flawlessly. I layer different skincare year round but this is my always moisturizer.

I've tried many moisturizers and serums to fix my skin barrier after I destroyed it doing a 10 step care routine. So far, this works to make my cheeks less red without giving me acne. It also lessened a wrinkle caused by an acne scar.

I originally bought this product when it was on sale. I liked it well enough, but it ended up taking a backseat to my other well-loved lotions and creams. Then I got pregnant and developed cystic acne on my chin that was painful, and I couldnt get it to go away. I tried switching out my favorite Cerve nighttime cream for this Avene cream and OMG those large, deep pimples cleared up in a matter of days! I'm so thankful I had this on hand and will definitely be repurchasing.
Worked wonders for me and all the small bumps on my skin disappeared after using this

I absolutely love this stuff and always have a bottle on hand! Its great for sensitive skin that is prone to irritation. Any time I've had skin reactions on my face, this is the product I reach for to help with the itchiness and dryness. It's very hydrating (a bit thicker) while still working well with oily skin. I especially love using this in the colder and drier winter months.

I had high hopes for this product but it caused itching after applying. It also pilled and felt like it left an unpleasant film on my face. After three days I developed a few breakouts and clogged pores. It's poorly formulated.

avis.titre: This seems like a great product
avis.texte: But unfortunately it doesn't work well for me. I haven't found a moisturizer that doesn't cause my face to turn red and feel hot to the touch
I have been using Avenue for years. Sometimes in the winter or summer my skin gets irritated. A few days of tolerance control cream and my skin is soothed and healed

This works for me. In fact, it is almost like a miracle. I have very reactive rosacea prone skin. The description says that it restores skin's barrier, soothes visible redness, tightness, and overheating. I've used an entire tube, and for me, it really does what it says. The added bonus is that it is preservative free. This is definitely worth a try if you suffer with reactive skin or rosacea flares. I have not had a flare since using this product.
Bring back the original extreme emulsion moisturizer please. This does not work the same and you've lost many loyal customers over the formula change. We beg :(

I've been using this moisturizer since my dermatologist recommended it for me ten years ago and I love it! It's great for dry, sensitive skin and it has never caused blemishes. It's a staple in my skincare routine.

I use this as a night time moisturizer during warm weather. I started using this when I had a really bad rash and acne on my face due to over washing and high humid whether. It kept my skin moisturizered while it healed and did not cause more skin issues. Pros: light, moisturizing, good for my sensitive skin, no smell, does the job in spring and summer months when humidity and heat is high Cons: too light for cold months, small amount for the amount you get and the cost but it does last for a season or so
Even with 30 per cent discount, way too expensive, especially for cost. Many less expensive, just as effective alternatives.

I have rosacea. I've been dealing with a huge flareup for the past 2 months. Pustules, extreme redness, and a damaged moisture barrier. I finally got the pustules gone, but the redness was still terrible along with my moisture barrier. For whatever reason, my go to Cetaphil was not doing its job. Read something about this Avene stuff, so I decided to give it a try. Wow. WOW! Not only did it get my moisture barrier in check, it calmed the redness down CONSIDERABLY! IDK what's in this stuff, but it's magic. I will continue to buy!

avis.titre: Excelente una bendicion, en mi vida.
avis.texte: Lo use en un momento muy critico de mi vida, mi piel tenia como quemaduras por quimicos, fue una bendicion yo no estaba confiada porque fue mi dermatology, que me dijo y me lo mostro por internet. Yo eperaba que me enviara alguna na formula medica, fue maravilloso poder usar estos productos lo he recomendado a mi famila, porque somos sensible de piel. Lo he compredo como regalo de Navidad

avis.titre: GET IT DO NOT HESITATE RUN TO THE REGISTER TO Pay itt
avis.texte: Wow! Ive tried it all, seriously I have. My mother in law has the most precious skin shes 60 and if you see her shes Better looking than any celebrity, yes even Aniston, but she gatekeeps her skincare. One say i saw her getting an avene moisturizer out her purse. I bought it ofcourse. TODAY, three days after i bought, my friend looked at me and said "Youre skin looks so Beautiful, so soft and flawless". UMM MISS GIRL, I HAD TO RUN to give this GEM A REVIEW! Like COMMONNNN GO VIRALLLL NOWWW so they never discontinue it

avis.titre: It works and I love the packaging
avis.texte: The packaging is genius — no frustrating waste, even when the tube is almost empty. My skin also loves this cream — some recent outbreaks of bumps and redness disappeared almost immediately. The cream doesn't feel hydrating, but I know it is. It disappears into the skin as soon as you apply.

avis.titre: Comedogenic, Bring Back Tolerance Emulsion Light
avis.texte: This suggested replacement for the Tolerance Extreme Emulsion Light formula is not great. It contains comedogenic/pore-clogging ingredients Ethylhexyl Palmitate and Beeswax/Cera Alba (in place of the Mineral Oil which was great). Maybe the original French-made versions are still available somewhere, who knows. America slacks on the healthy ingredients to save $$.
I have rosacea and this is my go to product that doesn't irritate my skin!!! Absolutely love it! I have already finished 3 bottles!

avis.titre: I only use this on my face.
avis.texte: I'm prone to mila and have sensitive skin and this is my go to. I do wish it was more moisturizing but works great for sensitive skin.
This product is great at calming and soothing. It also helps to repair my skin barrier support and provides hydration. I like to use it as a night cream!
Buena crema para irritaciones, espero que después agreguen filtro solar al producto
My face seems..repaired. Smoother and more elastic. Clean and fresh.

avis.titre: Please bring back the old formula
avis.texte: This does g moisturize and hydrate nearly as well and richly and noticeably as the recovery cream. Not a good replacement. I'm sure you had your reasons and high hopes but please please help the public out and also offer the other recover cream again. I stocked up with 10 of them but they will expire soon!!

I purchased this product since they promoted it as a "replacement" for the extreme cream that they discontinued. Mind you, the extreme line products were the only moisturizers I've been able to use on my face because of struggles with rosacea and dermatitis. I was heartbroken when I saw they discontinued the line, but had high hopes for the tolerance control cream. After applying it on my face before bed, I woke up with tiny white heads and hot, blotchy skin that has yet to calm down even hours after washing and applying cold compresses. I really wish this company would bring back their extreme line - I know several others who had success with the extreme cream but found this new tolerance control line to be irritating. Why mess with something good? That's a surefire way to lose one-faithful customers.

avis.titre: Terrible replacement for old Skin Recovery Cream
avis.texte: Avene says this is the replacement for the Skin Recovery Cream but it has completely different ingredients including fatty alcohols which break so many people out, myself included. Skin Recovery Cream was the one good moisturizer without fatty alcohols which is why it was so popular but this new one is just like any other moisturizer out there.

Eczema in my eyebrows has cost eyebrow hair loss which left me with red, dry, flakey eyebrows that has been embarrassing for me. I would catch myself rubbing or itching my eyebrow only to cause flakes galore and not have anything to help with the itching. In first use I had improvement and now with daily use I have almost zero flakes, it soothes the itching, and the redness has drastically demolished. I've used this for about 2 months now and started very regiment. I am at the point of miss a day of this but have used other products like the thermal water or tolerance cleaner, I still am able to maintain the improvements. However due to the calming factor this beingsx I've started to carry it with me daily.
This is my go to for every morning. I love the lightness but wonderful coverage of it. I have been using it now for a few months. It is a great daily moisturizer. So pleased.
I have used this since Avane discontinued the cicalifate post procedural cream. It is always soothing and calming to my sensitive skin. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: If you have rosacea, stay away from this !!
avis.texte: Even though this is marketed for sensitive skin , this product contains CETEARYL ALCOHOL . After putting it on , my face was burning and bright red . It caused a huge flare up . Also contains squalane , which some people are also allergic to . I was deeply disappointed by this product . Do not waste your money on this .
Have extremely sensitive skin. Not sure which product causes hives.

avis.titre: Sad that Avène Tolerance Emulsion is no longer available
avis.texte: This product was recommended as a replacement for Avène Tolerance Emulsion. Sadly the beeswax contained in this product irritates seborrheic dermatitis.
I started using this brand several years ago and my dermatologist suggested it. I Love the good results I get

I tried Avene because I have folliculitis-prone skin. Many ingredients trigger a flare up for me and I'm always nervous to try new. So I used the intensive repair creme, and initially my skin felt and looked great, however after 1 week of use once/day, my skin became incredibly dry. I also used the cream along with the water spray. I believe both contributed to my skin being stripped of all moisture. My face was so dry and uncomfortable, it was also visibly peeling around my mouth and chin. After I stopped using the products, after about 4 days my skin went back to normal. I really wanted to love the products and the brand but unfortunately my skin did not agree.
This cream is soothing for sensitive skin. On some days when I am not sure if I should use a skincare product that has active ingredients, I always just reach for this cream.
This moisturizer is very creamy and helps the rosacea redness ! It is calming and I will continue to use it to keep my skin in its best condition
I have very sensitive skin and this cream moisturizes yet is gentle for my skin.
XeraCalm cleansing make my face red and dry. Tolerance recovery cream I love it. It works great in my skin.

avis.titre: Savior Product for Burns or When You Mess up
avis.texte: I am not a doctor. I am not giving medical advice. I have found this is savior product I refuse to be without for burns and my super sensitive highly reactive skin. IE, when I heat the oil too high in the kitchen and get a spot of oil splatter burn of my finger or hand. Or, now that my skin is sun sensitive I got a slight burn in the sun. If I had had this for my radiation treatment during my cancer I would have used it on my radiation burns too. I give this out during the holidays to friends and family because it is really that good. This and their mineral water have become two products I refuse to not have stockpiled and are two products I would like to have on hand during a zombie apocalypse. I am writing this review today because I just messed up my skin barrier with another company's Niacinamide and Arbutin serum, frying my skin in the less than 5 minutes it was on my skin. My skin was red and inflamed and hurting/burning. After slathering this on after washing the other company's products off I will not be ripping my face off tonight. That is not hyperbole. I have super sensitive skin and poor impulse control when it comes to scratching my skin off when it becomes this reactive/welty. Fortunately, I always have this on hand and stockpiled. Even when it, is me, myself who messes up (Like trying a new product when I know better). My face is still red and inflamed but it is not burning. Using this, I will wake up tomorrow morning with calm, skin. In a few days of use my sk
I bought this to help with some eczema on my face. Unfortunately, it did not heal the skin. It moisturized fine, but had no effect on the eczema.
Love Love Love the new packaging sooo much better than the previous difficult tube.
I am satisfied with this lotion for my sensitive skin. Did not cause the redness and burning sensation I get from many other lotions.

Last year I started getting dry patches around my eye and for months I didn't know what to do about it until I realized that I had eczema for the first time in my life. I did some research and Avené was highly rated across the board for clearing dry patches, so I decided to give it a go. Within a week, I stopped waking up with flaky skin in the corners of my eyes. I've started using it on my entire face too. Light, moisturizing, and effective. What else can you ask for?
Love your products, they're clean and pure! I've waited years to enjoy these creams! Thank you

I have tried a trillion of all kinds of creams for redness, including moisturizers with a green tint. NOTHING helped me as much as this cream! It immediately calms redness. I was shocked by how quick it acts, it never happened before. Very very much recommended!
I love avènes eyecream. But when i get flareups this is definitely going to be my new go to! The relief was instant! Ive waited weeks for this.
Love this! I have a very sensitive and dehydrated skin and this works perfectly fine. I have tried many different products and nothing worked till my dermatologist recommended me this.

I have used this cream now for a month. I have mild eczema on my body but I do not itch all the time and never on my face. But until now, my face had some redness, somewhat itching reaction for 2 months now. I do not know if it is part of eczema but the itching was above my cheekbone and around my eyes and sometimes my neck, and ears. So, now I use this cream and it has been very helpful. I use it now as a moisturizer too. I like how it feels, it gives a glow to your face. I do use the Avene Makeup Removing Micellar Water first. While I was waiting for my order of the Tolerance Control cream, I had on hand the Avene Cicalfate which I use for my fingers when they get itchy/dry from my eczema and this worked too on my face, which is a thick cream. So, far I will continue to use the Tolerance Control. My face feels much better now and I do not want to chance another outbreak. Yes, I do recommend. It helps with itchiness, redness and eczema.
Please, please bring back Tolerance Extreme Emulsion. Far superior product for those who are sensitive with combination skin.

I have used this product for 3weeks. The slight redness on my face is not diminished. I do not have rosacea. The moisture lasts about 5 hours, then my skin feels dry. I have normal skin, age 65, live in upstate NY. I will not purchase again.
Helps with my rosacea the best so far outside of laser treatment!
I use Tolerance because it is the only moisturizer I have found that doesn't irritate my skin.

I have been using Avene products for so many years. I use this twice a day. I don't react. It takes longer to absorb then the tolerance extreme of about 6-8 years ago Your prior products were far more superior and the compliments on my skin though dry, eczema and rosacea everyone asked me what products I used and I raved i think they are good not great

I searched for years for something for my dry, patchy, rosacea skin that also still broke out. I came across Avène soothing skin cream. It changed my skin from red and patchy to beautiful, glowy skin! It was also a great primer. I used it it for two years, then they changed it to this one when the other was discontinued. I got a tube and immediately the patches were back along with pimples all over. I was so disappointed! When I looked at the ingredients and they had taken away good old mineral oil and replaced it with skin clogging beeswax and a few minor changes. I can't use it, as my skin looks awful with this. I'm still looking for about a year now and have not found anything to compare with the original formula. You will see the reviews of others that hate this new one. Bring it back!

I have dry sensitive skin. When I first started using this product, it was a game changer but as I continued my skin started to hate it. Its a very thick, almost sunscreen like feel which I don't love. Theres a white cast too.
I have this ezcema soot that pops up in my chest from time to time and when i tried this, it whent away. No other moosturizer jas healed my skin like that.

avis.titre: nice facial moisturizer for dry/combination skin
avis.texte: Great at calming dry skin and reducing redness. Very moisturizing, but not too heavy of a consistency.

I had a nearly unbearable, itchy and bumpy rash on my arms and legs. I tried so many products to soothe the itch. Finally, I came across Avène Tolerance cream, and it was a game changer. It made the itch bearable while I healed. I now use the remaining cream on my face. It's not too heavy or greasy, perfectly right for my skin type.

This moisturizer is a game changer. In less than a minute you will see a more even skin tone with reduced redness. This is a great moisturizer for calming, and improving your skin barrier. Great for night time, or on days with no makeup.

This balm is the only moisturizer I've found that covers everything I need for my skin. It calms my skin and keeps it moisturized. I have severe Rosacea so I have to be careful what I use. I've been using this balm continuously for about a year and it's helped repair my damaged skin barrier and is part of my daily routine.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy this product.
avis.texte: I by this product regularly. It helps with my sensitive skin without being greasy or heavy.
This crème was recommended by my dermatologist for my dry sensitive skin and I love it..I saw improvement from day 1
Instantly calming. Perfect after any treatment from a peel to laser. I even use it a day after Microneedling.

It's lightweight, hydrates my skin, it makes my skin feel smooth and healthy. I apply it in the morning and before going to bed. I use this every day for my dry sensitive skin. I had an allergy reaction on may and I started using this, 2 months later I can say the hypersensitivity I had on my face is gone 80% . This is a winner for me and will use it forever! And the cilcalfate restorative skin cream. Btw, the packaging is very convenient for travel.
Feels nice on the skin w sufficient coverage. Does feel slightly a bit too rich.

I used the original tolerance extreme cream for years and was really disappointed to hear it had been discontinued. This cream is what Avene created to take it's place. I tried it once before but was not happy with it. Recently I decided to give it another try and I am happy that I did. I love the simplicity of the ingredients and that the sterile formula and packaging means no preservatives. It does a nice job with moisturizing and my face feels dewy in the morning. I am going to stick with this one and I recommend trying it.

Very nice & moisturizing creme but way too heavy to wear under makeup- at least for me in sumner and I have thirsty 54 year old skin. I adore this brand and I can handle fragrance so i will stick with the Hydrance.

This replaced the Tolerance Extreme cream, and they added citric acid. While this can be good for some kinds of skin, its not good for anyone with sensitive skin or rosacea since it can cause flare ups. Since this line is targeting sensitive skin, I found this very disappointing. Now need a new cream for my regimen.

My dermatologist & his esthetician both recommended Avene products for my highly reactive, aging, super dry and sun damaged skin. I can honestly say the products have made an amazing improvement in my skin in just two short months!! I no longer have hot red blotchy skin on my face. I had daily rosacea like pustules which are also gone! My skin is soft and moisturized with out feeling greasy. I love this product! Please don't ever stop making it! Thank you!
I am using this cream for 1 year already and it helps me with reducing redness and irritation on my skin. It is very calming for my sensitive skin. I often use along with antirougeurs cream.

This creme is truly fragrance free and it has a nice texture. I bought it to use after I got a sunburn. Unfortunately, once the burn was taken care of, this creme became too much for my skin. It didn't soak in as readily so I felt over-moisturized, but not in a good way. I live in a dry climate so this was surprising. I wouldn't recommend this unless you have naturally dry skin, are trying to address an extreme dryness situation or have a sunburn. It's just a bit much.
I have dry redness prone skin. I've used all the expensive creams, medical grade skincare. This is by far the best moisturizer I've used in years.
This is the perfect moisturizer and leaves my skin soft. Its great since i use trentanion - most moisturizers arent hydrating enough

I'll have to give this cream a five-star. I've been trying moisturizers from four brands at the same time, this is the only one that won't burn my face after a layer of tretinoin. The only con is it's not moisturizing enough, will be expecting something like hyaluronic acid or niacinamide in it.
I've had rosacea outbreaks for the last two years tried so many products within two days it calmed my skin!! Highly recommend

avis.titre: Great for sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: Wonderful. Does not break me out, soothes my skin. Moisturizing.
Have been using this product for at least 15 years… love the results!!

avis.titre: Worked well for my roommate but not for me
avis.texte: This deeply moisturizes but was a little too heavy for me. I have true combination skin and so it over moisturized my oily patches. My roommate's skin is a little drier than mine and it worked beautifully for her. Non-irritating, absorbs easily, good dispensing mechanism so five stars since it worked so well for my roommate and was accurately described.

Once I turned 30, my skin decided to become sensitive and had me narrowing down the products I could tolerate on my face. This cream provides sufficient hydration while being lightweight and non occlusive. I experienced no irritation upon application or hours afterwards, even when my skin was inflamed and ultra sensitive. It is great for the spring and summer months. I would love to try the heavier balm version in the fall and winter months. I also love that it is preservative free with sterile packaging. I have realized less is more when it comes to skincare for me as my skin ages.

avis.titre: Wonderful cream for very reactive and sensitive skins
avis.texte: This cream is wonderful for my very sensitive and reactive skin. It has limited ingredients which is great for reactive skins, no fragrance and really softens and protects my skin. Other avene creams either has fragrance or mineral oil which causes acne on my combination skin. This is the only one I can use knowing that it will not cause sensitivity or any reaction and also it's a good moisturizer. Please don't stop selling this!!!
I have rosacea.Most lotions, soaps and make up aggravate it. Avenue Tolerance Control burns very little. It is ok to use around the eye area. Worth the $$.
This product hydrates my skin without thick and sticky texture. LOVE IT!

avis.titre: My skin responds well to this product :)
avis.texte: Another great daily use facial product from Avene. My dermatologist recommended Avene products to me, too!

avis.titre: Not a good Replacement for Tolerance Emulsion
avis.texte: This was suggested as a replacement for the Tolerance Extreme emulsion which I used religiously and is now discontinued. This product has a much longer list of ingredients and immediately caused breakouts on my sensitive acne-prone skin. I am so disappointed. Please bring back the extreme Emulsion!

avis.titre: if you have sensitive skin use with caution!!!
avis.texte: I bought this cream after searching for a good eczema safe moisturizer on the National Eczema Association's website. My first impressions with this product were great, the packaging is nice, and with a sealed pump dispenser, really easy to keep protected from bacteria or oils from your hands, and the formula goes on fantastic! it was very moisturizing, and my skin looked bright and dewy after applying on top of a lighter moisturizer (I have used this moisturizer for years btw, so what I'm about to say was definitely not the fault of that product.) HOWEVER. within minutes of applying my skin began to itch, even on my hands where I had pumped the product, and it got worse and more intense as the night went on. I woke up the next day with lots of skin texture and redness, and my preexisting eczema had become inflamed and had spread to my jawline. I'd say if you have mildly sensitive/non sensitive skin, this is a great moisturizer if you're looking to reduce dryness or redness from sun damage/ daily life, but if you're like me with extremely reactive/sensitive skin, then this "sensitive skin formula" may not be for you. < 3
Love it ! I use for over a year and I love how my skin looks, feels hydrated .

avis.texte: This cream is very good for dry, irritated skin. I love the sterile packaging. It has helped my skin while using Vit A. avis.titre: Perfect. Upset I never tried before
avis.texte: My bar was not high for this product, I'll admit. My skin my irritated, red and itchy but I needed any form of moisture in my skin because while my current products at the time were irritating my sensitive skin, having extremely dry skin was also irritating me. Either way, I was irritated. When I stumbled upon the tolerance line, all I wanted was hydration and moisture in my skin that would not make me itch. I was not looking for a miracle. I was looking for something simple that could stabilize me even if it wasn't my ideal moisturizer or moisturizing enough. When I first put the formula on my hands I could not imagine how it would be hydrating enough, but thought it would be good for what I needed so long as it didn't irritate my skin. I was blown away, not only did this soothe my skin, it actually is really moisturizing and hydrating—way more than I expected for such a light formula. My skin feels so safe in this cream with so little ingredients. Why didn't I try sooner?
I have dry skin, living in Wyoming. This is light weight and provides great moisture. I will be reordering
